newsitem.title: MEXICO: Serfin cuts ICA '96, '97 EPS estimates.
newsitem.headline: Serfin cuts ICA '96, '97 EPS estimates.

text.p: Serfin brokerage said on Monday it reduced its 1996 and 1997 earnings per share estimates for construction firm Empresas ICA.
Serfin reduced its 1996 EPS estimate to 3.54 pesos from 3.68 pesos, and its 1997 estimate to 4.10 pesos from 8.60.
"We are reducing our 1997 EPS estimates for ICA in line with an updated economic outlook for Mexico," analyst Gerardo Saenz wrote in a report.
Saenz nonetheless reiterated his buy recommendation for ICA, based on a target price of 189 pesos for the share by the end of 1997.
ICA nominal shares were up 50 centavos at 133.50 pesos at mid-afternoon trade on Monday.
